CheckTitle: Account has automatic backups enabled globally
Description: Linode **account settings** are checked to ensure **automatic backups** are enabled globally.
Risk: Without backups, data loss from instance failures or accidental deletion is **unrecoverable**.

Code.Other:
1. Log in to the Linode Cloud Manager
2. Navigate to Account Setting under Administration
3. Click the switch under the Backup Auto Enrollment panel

Recommendation.Text: Enable Backup Auto Enrollment in account settings to enroll new Linodes in backups automatically.
